usage: jbus queue approve [-h] [--word ID] [--answer NUMBER]
                          [--message THREAD/MESSAGE] [--pick THREAD/ITEM]
                          [--rule N] [--follows SLUG] [--sha SHA]
                          [--seen EVENT]
                          slug

positional arguments:
  slug

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --word ID             a word `jbus word` kept, by its id
  --answer NUMBER       the answer that closed a question
  --message THREAD/MESSAGE
                        the user's own message in T3 Code; THREAD/last is the
                        user's newest message there
  --pick THREAD/ITEM    the user's own answer to a question box in T3 Code, by
                        its thread and its user_input_request item: it
                        approves the row a picked label names; THREAD/last is
                        the box answered last there
  --rule N              taken beside --follows and not read: the follow-up
                        rule is known by what it says
  --follows SLUG        the approved row that this one follows up: its go is
                        the ground
  --sha SHA             taken and not read: the go is for the brief as it is
                        stored, whose sha256 jbus keeps on the go
  --seen EVENT          the id of the last event you read (jbus events):
                        refused as stale when the row changed after it
